## The baseline function to calculate LPC flux per profile
```{r}
# Note that indiv_traits.SA needs to be curated for taxonomy
calculate_LPC_flux <- function(indiv_traits.SA, beta = -0.001) {
  
  # Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins
  # 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
  volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
    mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
    group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
    summarise(n5mbins = n(),
              Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
    select(-c(n5mbins))
  
  # 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
  df.100m.sums.SA <- indiv_traits.SA %>% 
    # Cap diapause duration to 240 days (for summary stats, already applied in the annual respiration calculation)
    mutate(diapause_dur_d = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                    240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
    # bin to 100 m layers
    mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
    # Summarize traits
    group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
    summarise(abundance = n(),
              biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
              structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
              waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
              # Convert respiration from ug C to mg C 
              respired_C_mgC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC) / 1000,
              # Calculate mean % fullness and prosome lengths
              mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
              mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
              # Calculate the mean duration of diapause (usd for mortality function)
              mean_diapause_dur_d = mean(diapause_dur_d),
              sd_diapause_dur_d = sd(diapause_dur_d), 
              .groups = "drop")
  
  # 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
  df.100m.conc.SA <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
    # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
    left_join(df.100m.sums.SA, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
    # replace NA with 0
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
    # concentration by volume (m3)
    mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
           biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
           structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
           waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
           respired_C_mgC_m3 = respired_C_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
    # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
    mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
           biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
           structural_gC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
           waxester_gC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
           respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000) %>% 
    # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
    select(-c(abundance, biomass_mgC, sd_diapause_dur_d,
              structural_mgC, waxester_mgC, respired_C_mgC)) %>% 
    # Zeros in the mean diapause duration, prosome length, and lipid fullness are NAs
    mutate(mean_diapause_dur_d = if_else(mean_diapause_dur_d == 0, NA, 
                                         mean_diapause_dur_d),
           mean_lipid_fullness = if_else(mean_lipid_fullness == 0, NA,
                                         mean_lipid_fullness),
           mean_prosome_length_mm = if_else(mean_prosome_length_mm == 0, NA,
                                            mean_prosome_length_mm))
  
  
  # Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
  # baseline was 0.001
  
  df.100m.conc.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
    # 2.1. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
    mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * mean_diapause_dur_d)) %>% 
    # 2.2 Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
    mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
           structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
                                      (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
           waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
                                    (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
    
    # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
    mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
    # NAs in total flux are zeros
    mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2), 0, 
                                      total_gC_flux_m2))
  
  
  # Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
  df.station.100m.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
    left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                select(sample_id, station_year),
              by = "sample_id") %>% 
    select(-sample_id) %>% 
    group_by(station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
    # Average all variables per 100m layer
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                     ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
              nprofiles = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # Establish factors
    mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))
  
  
  
  # Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
  df.profile.SA <- df.station.100m.SA %>% 
    group_by(station_year) %>% 
    summarise(n100mbins = n(),
              Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
              abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2, na.rm = T),
              biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
              structural_gC = sum(structural_gC_m2),
              waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_gC_m2),
              respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
              structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
              waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
              abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort, na.rm = T),
              total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
    mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
           fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
           fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
           frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
           frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
           frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
    # Add metadata
    left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
                distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
                select(station_year, region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk, 
                       Year, Month, 
                       longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                       maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
              by = "station_year") 
  
  return(df.profile.SA)
}

```


# SA1. Accounting for large copepods that are likely Calanus spp.
## Calculate flux
```{r}

# *** Check composition of images ***
indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(taxa) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            min_prosome_length_mm = min(prosome_length_mm),
            max_prosome_length_mm = max(prosome_length_mm),
            mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
            sd_prosome_length_mm = sd(prosome_length_mm),
            mean_prosome_total_mgC = mean(prosome_total_mgC),
            mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
            .groups = "drop")


# Calculate LPC flux without curating the taxonomy of indiv traits
# Calanus and Calanoida
df.profile.SA.A <- calculate_LPC_flux(indiv_traits %>% 
                                      filter(taxa %in% c("Calanus", "Calanoida")))
# Calanus + Calanoida and Copepoda
df.profile.SA.B <- calculate_LPC_flux(indiv_traits %>% 
                                      filter(taxa %in% c("Calanus", "Calanoida",
                                                         "Copepoda")))

```

## Compare with baseline
```{r}
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260331.RData")

compare.region.profiles.A <- left_join(
  df.profile %>% 
    select(station_year, region.inuktitut,
           baseline_total_gC_flux_m2 = total_gC_flux_m2),
  df.profile.SA.A %>% 
    select(station_year, region.inuktitut,
           SA1_total_gC_flux_m2 = total_gC_flux_m2) ) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "Calanoida")
compare.region.profiles.B <- left_join(
  df.profile %>% 
    select(station_year, region.inuktitut,
           baseline_total_gC_flux_m2 = total_gC_flux_m2),
  df.profile.SA.B %>% 
    select(station_year, region.inuktitut,
           SA1_total_gC_flux_m2 = total_gC_flux_m2) ) %>% 
  mutate(scenario = "Calanoida + Copepoda")

# Are increased counts statistically significant?
SA1.table <- bind_rows(compare.region.profiles.A, compare.region.profiles.B) %>%
  group_by(scenario, region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p_value = wilcox.test(
              SA1_total_gC_flux_m2,
              baseline_total_gC_flux_m2,
              paired = TRUE)$p.value,
            
    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_baseline = median(baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_increase = median(SA1_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_increase = mean(SA1_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_increase = sd(SA1_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percent_increase_mean = 100 * mean_increase / mean_baseline,
    percent_increase_sd = 100 * sd_increase / mean_baseline) %>% 
  mutate( significance = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05  ~ "*", .default = "NS") )%>% 
  select(-c(mean_baseline, median_baseline))
```

# SA2. Respiration rate model parameters
## Calculate fluxes
The min respiration rate is based on the standard errors for b and Em in eq. 9
```{r}
# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins

# 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
  select(-c(n5mbins))

# 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
df.100m.sums.SA <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Cap diapause duration to 240 days 
  mutate(diapause_dur_d = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                  240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # bin to 100 m layers
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
  # Summarize traits
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
            # Convert respiration from ug C to mg C 
            respired_C_mgC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC) / 1000,
            respired_C_mgC_min = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_min) / 1000,
            respired_C_mgC_max = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC_max) / 1000,
            # Calculate mean % fullness and prosome lengths
            mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
            mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
            # Calculate the mean duration of diapause (usd for mortality function)
            mean_diapause_dur_d = mean(diapause_dur_d),
            sd_diapause_dur_d = sd(diapause_dur_d), 
            .groups = "drop")

# 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
df.100m.conc.SA <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
  # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
  left_join(df.100m.sums.SA, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # concentration by volume (m3)
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3 = respired_C_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3_min = respired_C_mgC_min/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3_max = respired_C_mgC_max/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
         biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2_min = respired_C_mgC_m3_min * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2_max = respired_C_mgC_m3_max * depth_height_m / 1000) %>% 
  # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
  select(-c(abundance, biomass_mgC, sd_diapause_dur_d,
            structural_mgC, waxester_mgC, respired_C_mgC)) %>% 
  # Zeros in the mean diapause duration, prosome length, and lipid fullness are NAs
  mutate(mean_diapause_dur_d = if_else(mean_diapause_dur_d == 0, NA, 
                                       mean_diapause_dur_d),
         mean_lipid_fullness = if_else(mean_lipid_fullness == 0, NA,
                                       mean_lipid_fullness),
         mean_prosome_length_mm = if_else(mean_prosome_length_mm == 0, NA,
                                          mean_prosome_length_mm))


# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

df.100m.conc.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  # 2.1. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * mean_diapause_dur_d)) %>% 
  # 2.2 Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
           (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
           (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort,
         total_gC_flux_m2_min = respired_C_gC_m2_min + 
           structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort,
         total_gC_flux_m2_max = respired_C_gC_m2_max + 
           structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs in total flux are zeros
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2),
         total_gC_flux_m2_min = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2_min), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2_min),
         total_gC_flux_m2_max = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2_max), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2_max))


# Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
df.station.100m.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 100m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))



# Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.SA <- df.station.100m.SA %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
            
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2_min = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_min),
            respired_C_gC_m2_max = sum(respired_C_gC_m2_max),
            
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_min = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_min),
            total_gC_flux_m2_max = sum(total_gC_flux_m2_max),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause.
  mutate(fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_min = total_gC_flux_m2_min / biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_C_flux_max = total_gC_flux_m2_max / biomass_gC_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk, 
                     Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year")


# Step 4. Calculate regional averages
df.region.SA <- df.profile.SA %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(biomass_gC_m2:fraction_C_flux_max,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

```

## Compare with baseline
```{r}
ggplot(df.region.SA, 
       aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_mean, color = region.inuk)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point(aes(y = total_gC_flux_m2_min_mean)) +

# Are increased counts statistically significant?
SA2.table_min <- df.profile.SA %>%
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p_value = wilcox.test(
              total_gC_flux_m2_min,
              total_gC_flux_m2,
              paired = TRUE)$p.value,
            
    mean_baseline = mean(total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_baseline = median(total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_diff = median(total_gC_flux_m2_min - total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),

    sd_diff = sd(total_gC_flux_m2_min - total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percent_diff_mean = 100 * mean_diff / mean_baseline,
    percent_diff_sd = 100 * sd_diff / mean_baseline) %>% 
  select(-c(mean_baseline, median_baseline))

SA2.table_max <- df.profile.SA %>%
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p_value = wilcox.test(
              total_gC_flux_m2_max,
              total_gC_flux_m2,
              paired = TRUE)$p.value,
            
    mean_baseline = mean(total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_baseline = median(total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_diff = median(total_gC_flux_m2_max - total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff = mean(total_gC_flux_m2_max - total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_diff = sd(total_gC_flux_m2_max - total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percent_diff_mean = 100 * mean_diff / mean_baseline,
    percent_diff_sd = 100 * sd_diff / mean_baseline) %>% 
  select(-c(mean_baseline, median_baseline))

SA2.table <- left_join(SA2.table_min, SA2.table_max,
                       by = "region.inuktitut")

write.csv(SA2.table, row.names = F,
          file = "tables/SA2_results_20260331.csv")
```

# SA3. Temperature term
## Calculate
```{r}
# TODO get mean temperature below 200 m for each profile...
load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260330.RData")
rm(ctd, ctd_profiles, temp_profiles)

AA <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T)

BB <- uvp6_ctd_match %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% AA$sample_id)

CC <- temp_profiles_100 %>% 
  filter(filename %in% BB$ctd_filename) %>% 
  filter(depth_bin >= 200) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(temp.mean)) %>% 
  left_join(BB %>% 
              select(filename = ctd_filename, region),
            by = "filename") %>% 
  left_join(region_rename %>% 
              select(region, region.inuk), by = "region") %>% 
  # Calculate average per profile
  group_by(filename, region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(temperature = mean(temp.mean),
            .groups = "drop") 

# Calculate average per region
temp.regions <- CC %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(temperature_mean = mean(temperature),
            temperature_sd = sd(temperature),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

rm(AA, BB, CC, uvp6_ctd_match, temp_profiles_100)

# Recalculate indiv traits...

# SCENARIO A: constant <200 m temperature for the region
bb <- 2.27# Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.6 # Activation energy

indiv_traits.SA <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  
  # Link object ID to region.inuk
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, region.inuk), by = "sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(temp.regions, by = "region.inuk") %>% 

  mutate(temperature_kelvin = temperature_mean+273.15) %>% 
  
  # Calculate diapause respiration rate and duration
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         WE_ugC = waxester_mass_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*WE_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 

  # Cap the diapause duration capped to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_cap = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # The total C respired for the entire duration of diapause by the individual (ug C)
  mutate(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC = 
           respirationRate_ugCday * diapauseDuration_day_cap) %>%  
  # mutate(percent_WE_respired = diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC/WE_ugC * 100) %>% 
  select(-c(mass_ugC, WE_ugC, diapauseDuration_day_cap)) 

df.profile.SA.A <- calculate_LPC_flux(indiv_traits.SA)


# SCENARIO B: constant temperature of 1degC
indiv_traits.SA <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 

  mutate(temperature_kelvin = 1+273.15) %>% 
  
  # Calculate diapause respiration rate and duration
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         WE_ugC = waxester_mass_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*WE_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 

  # Cap the diapause duration capped to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_cap = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # The total C respired for the entire duration of diapause by the individual (ug C)
  mutate(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC = 
           respirationRate_ugCday * diapauseDuration_day_cap) %>%  
  # mutate(percent_WE_respired = diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC/WE_ugC * 100) %>% 
  select(-c(mass_ugC, WE_ugC, diapauseDuration_day_cap))
```

```{r}
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260331.RData")

compare.region.profiles.A <- left_join(

compare.region.profiles.B <- left_join(
  df.profile %>% 
    select(station_year, region.inuktitut,

# Are increased counts statistically significant?
SA3.table <- bind_rows(compare.region.profiles.A, compare.region.profiles.B) %>%
  group_by(scenario, region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p_value = wilcox.test(
              SA3_total_gC_flux_m2,
              baseline_total_gC_flux_m2,
              paired = TRUE)$p.value,
            
    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_baseline = median(baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_diff = median(SA3_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff  = mean(SA3_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_diff = sd(SA3_total_gC_flux_m2 - baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    percent_diff_mean = 100 * mean_diff  / mean_baseline,
    percent_diff_sd = 100 * sd_diff  / mean_baseline) %>% 
  mutate( significance = case_when(
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05  ~ "*", .default = "NS") )%>% 
  select(-c(mean_baseline, median_baseline))
```

# SA4. Mortality rate
## Calculate with function
```{r}
# Wrap the calculations in a single function
vary_mortality <- function(beta) {

# Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins
# 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
  select(-c(n5mbins))

# 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
df.100m.sums.SA <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Cap diapause duration to 240 days (for summary stats, already applied in the annual respiration calculation)
  mutate(diapause_dur_d = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                  240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # bin to 100 m layers
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
  # Summarize traits
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
            # Convert respiration from ug C to mg C 
            respired_C_mgC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC) / 1000,
            # Calculate mean % fullness and prosome lengths
            mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
            mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
            # Calculate the mean duration of diapause (usd for mortality function)
            mean_diapause_dur_d = mean(diapause_dur_d),
            sd_diapause_dur_d = sd(diapause_dur_d), 
            .groups = "drop")

# 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
df.100m.conc.SA <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
  # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
  left_join(df.100m.sums.SA, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # concentration by volume (m3)
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3 = respired_C_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
         biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000) %>% 
  # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
  select(-c(abundance, biomass_mgC, sd_diapause_dur_d,
            structural_mgC, waxester_mgC, respired_C_mgC)) %>% 
  # Zeros in the mean diapause duration, prosome length, and lipid fullness are NAs
  mutate(mean_diapause_dur_d = if_else(mean_diapause_dur_d == 0, NA, 
                                       mean_diapause_dur_d),
         mean_lipid_fullness = if_else(mean_lipid_fullness == 0, NA,
                                       mean_lipid_fullness),
         mean_prosome_length_mm = if_else(mean_prosome_length_mm == 0, NA,
                                          mean_prosome_length_mm))


# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins
# baseline was 0.001

df.100m.conc.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  # 2.1. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * mean_diapause_dur_d)) %>% 
  # 2.2 Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
           (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
           (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs in total flux are zeros
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2))


# Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
df.station.100m.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 100m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))



# Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.SA <- df.station.100m.SA %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2, na.rm = T),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
            structural_gC = sum(structural_gC_m2),
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort, na.rm = T),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk, 
                     Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year") %>% 
    mutate(beta = BB*-1,
           scenario = paste0("beta -", BB)) %>% 
    relocate(scenario)

  return(df.profile.SA)
}

# Loop through different values of beta
df.mort.scens <- data.frame()
for (BB in c(0.0001, 0.00025, 0.0005, 0.00075, 0.001, 0.0015, 0.002, 0.0025, 0.003)) {
  df <- vary_mortality(beta = BB*-1) 
  
  df.mort.scens <- bind_rows(df.mort.scens, df)
}
```

```{r}
# How much does a change in mortality affect the average LPC flux per region?

         total_gC_flux_m2) %>%

            by = "station_year")
  
  
SA4.table <- comp.total.SA %>%
  group_by(region.inuk, beta, scenario) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p_value = wilcox.test(

    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_total_gC_flux_m2, na.rm = TRUE),

    percent_increase_mean = 100 * mean_diff / mean_baseline,
    percent_increase_sd = 100 * sd_diff / mean_baseline) %>%

    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***", p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05  ~ "*", .default = "NS") )%>%

    guides(fill = guide_colorbar( barwidth = 15,  barheight = 1)),
  
  
  ggplot(SA4.table, aes(x = as.factor(beta), y = region.inuk,

    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
```

# SA5. Epipelagic winter residence
## Calculate
```{r}
# For the population in upper 200 m*, exclude % from the mortality and respiration flux calculations by simply reducing abundance.
vary_winterActivity <- function(fracResident) {
  beta = -0.001
  
  # Step 1. Calculate abundance, biomass, and respiration in 100 m bins
# 1.1 Integrate volume of water sampled to 100 m depth bins
volumes.df.100 <- volumes.df %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(Depth_5m / 100) * 100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depth_height_m = 5 * n5mbins) %>% 
  select(-c(n5mbins))

# 1.2 Sum all individuals and C traits in a 100 m depth bin
df.100m.sums.SA <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # only include Calanus spp
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Cap diapause duration to 240 days (for summary stats, already applied in the annual respiration calculation)
  mutate(diapause_dur_d = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                  240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # bin to 100 m layers
  mutate(Depth_100m = floor(object_depth_max/100) * 100) %>% 
  # Summarize traits
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            biomass_mgC = sum(prosome_total_mgC),
            structural_mgC = sum(structural_carbon_mgC),
            waxester_mgC = sum(waxester_mass_mgC),
            # Convert respiration from ug C to mg C 
            respired_C_mgC = sum(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC) / 1000,
            # Calculate mean % fullness and prosome lengths
            mean_lipid_fullness = mean(lipid_fullness),
            mean_prosome_length_mm = mean(prosome_length_mm),
            # Calculate the mean duration of diapause (usd for mortality function)
            mean_diapause_dur_d = mean(diapause_dur_d),
            sd_diapause_dur_d = sd(diapause_dur_d), 
            .groups = "drop")

# 1.3 Calculate concentrations in 100 m depth bins
df.100m.conc.SA <- volumes.df.100  %>% 
  # combine volume and 100 m bin sums (note that bins with zero values mean no Calanus spp observed)
  left_join(df.100m.sums.SA, by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_100m)) %>% 
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>% 
  # concentration by volume (m3)
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance/Sampled_volume_m3,
         biomass_mgC_m3 = biomass_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         structural_mgC_m3 = structural_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         waxester_mgC_m3 = waxester_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3,
         respired_C_mgC_m3 = respired_C_mgC/Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  
  # Here the abundance and biomass of the upper 200 m  population is reduced
  mutate(abundance_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                abundance_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                abundance_m3),
         biomass_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                biomass_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                biomass_mgC_m3),
         structural_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                structural_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                structural_mgC_m3),
         waxester_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                waxester_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                waxester_mgC_m3),
         respired_C_mgC_m3 = if_else(Depth_100m < 200,
                                respired_C_mgC_m3 * (1-fracResident),
                                respired_C_mgC_m3)) %>% 
  
  # concentration by area (m2), convert mg C to g C
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * depth_height_m,
         biomass_gC_m2 = biomass_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         structural_gC_m2 = structural_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         waxester_gC_m2 = waxester_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000,
         respired_C_gC_m2 = respired_C_mgC_m3 * depth_height_m / 1000) %>% 
  # Exclude the columns that are not concentrations
  select(-c(abundance, biomass_mgC, sd_diapause_dur_d,
            structural_mgC, waxester_mgC, respired_C_mgC)) %>% 
  # Zeros in the mean diapause duration, prosome length, and lipid fullness are NAs
  mutate(mean_diapause_dur_d = if_else(mean_diapause_dur_d == 0, NA, 
                                       mean_diapause_dur_d),
         mean_lipid_fullness = if_else(mean_lipid_fullness == 0, NA,
                                       mean_lipid_fullness),
         mean_prosome_length_mm = if_else(mean_prosome_length_mm == 0, NA,
                                          mean_prosome_length_mm))


# Step 2. Calculate mortality for 100 m bins

df.100m.conc.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  # 2.1. Calculate the fraction of the population lost to natural mortality
  mutate(mortality.coef =  exp(beta * mean_diapause_dur_d)) %>% 
  # 2.2 Calculate the abundance, structural, and lipid carbon lost
  mutate(abundance_m2_mort = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * mortality.coef),
         structural_gC_m2_mort = (structural_gC_m2 - 
           (structural_gC_m2 * mortality.coef)),
         waxester_gC_m2_mort = (waxester_gC_m2 - 
           (waxester_gC_m2 * mortality.coef))) %>% 
  
  # 2.3. Calculate total carbon flux
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = respired_C_gC_m2 + structural_gC_m2_mort + waxester_gC_m2_mort) %>% 
  # NAs in total flux are zeros
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2 = if_else(is.na(total_gC_flux_m2), 0, 
                                    total_gC_flux_m2))


# Step 3. Combine profiles with the same sample_stationid_ed
df.station.100m.SA <- df.100m.conc.SA %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_100m) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 100m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Establish factors
  mutate(Depth_100m = factor(Depth_100m, levels = seq(0,2500,100)))

# Step 4. Vertically integrate each profile (/m2)
df.profile.SA <- df.station.100m.SA %>% 
  group_by(station_year) %>% 
  summarise(n100mbins = n(),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2, na.rm = T),
            biomass_gC_m2 = sum(biomass_gC_m2),
            structural_gC = sum(structural_gC_m2),
            waxester_gC_m2 = sum(waxester_gC_m2),
            respired_C_gC_m2 = sum(respired_C_gC_m2),
            structural_gC_m2_mort = sum(structural_gC_m2_mort),
            waxester_gC_m2_mort = sum(waxester_gC_m2_mort),
            abundance_m2_mort = sum(abundance_m2_mort, na.rm = T),
            total_gC_flux_m2 = sum(total_gC_flux_m2),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # The fraction of the population that experience mortality, the fraction of total carbon lost to C flux during diapause. Also fraction of the flux components
  mutate(we_perc_biom = waxester_gC_m2/biomass_gC_m2,
         fraction_dead = abundance_m2_mort / abundance_m2,
         fraction_C_flux = total_gC_flux_m2 / biomass_gC_m2,
         frac_resp_total = respired_C_gC_m2 / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_strut_total = structural_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2,
         frac_waxe_total = waxester_gC_m2_mort / total_gC_flux_m2) %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              arrange(-maxSampleDepth) %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, region.inuktitut, region.inuk, reg.inuk, 
                     Year, Month, 
                     longitude = object_lon, latitude = object_lat, 
                     maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year") %>% 
    mutate(fracResident = fracResident,
           scenario = paste0("Resident fraction ", fracResident)) %>% 
    relocate(scenario)

  return(df.profile.SA)
}


df.resi.scens <- data.frame()
for (WR in seq(0,1,0.1)) {
  df <- vary_winterActivity(fracResident = WR)
  
  df.resi.scens <- bind_rows(df.resi.scens, df)
}
```

# SA6. Using Random Forest-based trait estimates
## Recalculate indiv_traits and LPC flux
```{r}
library(randomForest)
# The segmented images and morphological traits of calanoids
load("data/uvp6_CNN_segmentations_morphotraits_20260320.RData")

# Open the model generated in the chunk above
load("functions/random_forest_carbon_trait_models_20260321.RData")

morpho.traits <- all.copepods.uvp6 %>% 
  filter(object_annotation_category %in% 
                            c("Calanus","top-bottom<with visible lipid sac",
                              "side<with visible lipid sac"))

# Apply the Random forest models which already predict for structural and lipidWE carbon in mgC
structural_predicted <-  predict(rf.model.structural.mgC,
               newdata = morpho.traits %>% 
                 select(Major:PerimMajor), predict.all = T)

lipid_predicted <- predict(rf.model.lipid.mgC,
               newdata = morpho.traits %>% 
                 select(Major:PerimMajor), predict.all = T)

prosome_length_predicted <- predict(rf.model.prosome.mm,
               newdata = morpho.traits %>% 
                 select(Major:PerimMajor), predict.all = T)

morpho.traits$structural_carbon_mgC <- structural_predicted$aggregate
morpho.traits$waxester_mass_mgC <- lipid_predicted$aggregate
morpho.traits$prosome_length_mm <- prosome_length_predicted$aggregate

# Calculate total carbon, lipid fullness, respiration rates and diapause duration
bb <- 2.27# Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.6 # Activation energy

morpho.traits <- morpho.traits %>% 
  select(object_id, sample_id, object_depth_max,
         Depth_5m:prosome_length_mm) %>% 
  mutate(prosome_total_mgC = structural_carbon_mgC + waxester_mass_mgC) %>% 
  mutate(lipid_fullness = waxester_mass_mgC / prosome_total_mgC * 100) %>% 
  mutate(total_carbon_mgC = structural_carbon_mgC + waxester_mass_mgC) %>% 
  
  # Calculate diapause respiration rate and duration
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         WE_ugC = waxester_mass_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*WE_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 

  # Cap the diapause duration capped to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_cap = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # The total C respired for the entire duration of diapause by the individual (ug C)
  mutate(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC = 
           respirationRate_ugCday * diapauseDuration_day_cap)
  
# Calculate flux  
LPC_flux_RF <- calculate_LPC_flux(morpho.traits)

rm(all.copepods.uvp6, excluded_profiles, segmented.images, 
   lipid_predicted, structural_predicted, prosome_length_predicted,
   rf.model.structural.mgC, rf.model.prosome.mm, rf.model.lipid.mgC)
```

# SA7. Accounting for natural mortality in July and August... before the winter diapause?
Tricky if there are individuals at the bottom already... likely in diapause
```{r}
beta <- -0.001

# How many july and august samples?
AA <- df.profile %>% 
  # filter(Month <= 8) %>% # 45% of profiles

  # Calculate % of individuals that would have natural mortality from sampling date to Aug 31 (Sep1 is 244)
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, DOY)) %>% 
  mutate(tMinusSeptember = 244 - DOY) %>% 
  mutate(summer.mortality.coef =  exp(beta * tMinusSeptember)) %>% 
  
  # so that Sept-Oct do not have extra mortality
  mutate(summer.mortality.coef = if_else(DOY >= 244, 1, summer.mortality.coef)) %>% 
  
  mutate(summer.mort.abundance = abundance_m2 - (abundance_m2 * 
                                                   summer.mortality.coef),
         summer.mort.biomass = biomass_gC_m2 - (biomass_gC_m2 *
                                                  summer.mortality.coef),
         summer.mort.LPCflux = total_gC_flux_m2 - (total_gC_flux_m2 *
                                                     summer.mortality.coef)) %>% 
  mutate(perc.diff.abun = summer.mort.abundance / abundance_m2 * 100,
         perc.diff.biom = summer.mort.biomass / biomass_gC_m2 * 100,
         perc.diff.lpcf = summer.mort.LPCflux / total_gC_flux_m2 * 100) %>% 
  relocate(DOY, tMinusSeptember, summer.mort.abundance, summer.mort.biomass,
           summer.mort.LPCflux,
           perc.diff.abun, perc.diff.biom, perc.diff.lpcf)
  
# Remove the lpcf flux from July & Aug to the final counts and recalculate regional values
BB <- AA %>% 
  select(summer.mort.LPCflux, summer.mort.abundance, summer.mort.biomass,
         total_gC_flux_m2, abundance_m2, biomass_gC_m2, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  mutate(LPCflux = total_gC_flux_m2 - summer.mort.LPCflux,
         WinterAbundace = abundance_m2 - summer.mort.abundance,
         WinterBiomass = biomass_gC_m2 - summer.mort.biomass) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(perc.diff = (LPCflux-total_gC_flux_m2) / total_gC_flux_m2 * 100) %>% 
  relocate(total_gC_flux_m2, LPCflux, perc.diff)

```
